profile.headline: Fullstack Engineer | React, Next.Js, Node.Js, NestJs |
profile.summary:
I’m a fullstack software engineer with 3+ years of experience building reliable, scalable systems. From backend APIs and observability pipelines to interactive frontends using React and MUI. My strengths lie in clean architecture, async messaging, and building tools that feel invisible to the user but essential to the business.

I thrive in fast-moving teams where engineering and product are tightly connected. I’ve worked on messaging infrastructure at scale, built real-time interfaces used by healthcare teams, and contributed to design systems using TanStack Query and Playwright for E2E testing.

I'm also someone who’s chronically online, which I’ve learned is a strength. I understand the nuances of social platforms, how users behave, and how great product decisions transition into broader growth outcomes. I want to help startups ship faster, think smarter, and bring products to life that people actually want to use.

positions.title: Software Engineer l
positions.description:
- Reduced UI load time by 50% for high-volume enterprise inboxes (~1.3M daily messages) via virtualization.
- Integrated OpenTelemetry metrics and Grafana dashboards to enable real-time alerting and performance monitoring for core APIs.
- Designed an asynchronous webhook delivery system using AWS SQS to handle third-party SMS status updates, improving reliability and vendor-facing response clarity.
- Created an Istio-based API Gateway with IP blocking, rate limiting, and JWT authentication, improving security and throughput.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintained SendMessagingAPI, a core service used 10M+ times/month in clinical workflows.
- Delivered a full integration test suite, achieving zero bugs post-deployment.
- Diagnosed and resolved a Sev 1 database race condition, preventing ~30K failed requests/month.
- Migrated a core messaging service to NestJS with JWT authentication and OAuth 2.0 compliance
